question: Does the one-victim relocation region exclude positions that removal could enable?
source_review: Incoming placement uses evict_window, enclosing all primary/child rectangles and their maximum pair clearance. Displaced-group reseating searches board-wide subject to hard near domains. Two-victim incoming seating is also board-wide.
coverage: 54 combinations of primary masks 1/2/3, opposite-face children, negative/zero/positive child offsets, symmetric/asymmetric halo configurations and signed directional insets. Enumerate 64x64 half-millimetre origins, retaining board-legal candidates. Independently decompose rectangle pairs and verify collision status against exhaustive occupancy before testing containment.
decision: Do not remove or widen the region without a counterexample; this finite property set found no lost opportunity. It is not a proof over all real-valued geometry.
next_direction: Two-victim retry currently explores alternate positions only for the first victim's selected legal shape. If that shape seats but blocks the second victim, alternate first-victim shapes are not explored as a coupled choice. Investigate that combination with rollback/accounting tests and a measured carrier screen.
limits: No production algorithm change, new smaller layout, full-board qualification or exhaustive project test run. No hardware restrictions weakened.
